biggest_catch: Time-boxed: the friend must open the eligible checking account between September 8, 2026 and October 31, 2026 — after that, the $150 promotional amount ends.
catches: Limited-time promotion: eligible accounts must be opened September 8, 2026 – October 31, 2026.
Friend must complete at least $300 in ACH direct deposits, 15 debit purchases, and online banking/eStatements enrollment within 60 days of opening.
Annual earnings cap of $600 in reward cards.

c1.evidence: Verifiable program on institution's official domain: Security Bank of Kansas City's official page (securitybankkc.com/personal/refer-a-friend) runs a limited-time Refer-A-Friend promotion.

c2.evidence: Concrete per-referral payout: the referrer earns a $150 Mastercard Reward Card for each friend who opens an eligible checking account and satisfies all program requirements, up to $600 per year (i.e., 4 paid referrals).

c3.evidence: Mechanism: register as a referrer (online via ReferLive, in-branch, or by phone); invite friends via contact info/email, a personal link, or the ReferLive app; friend registers through the referral and opens a new eligible personal checking account between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-31.

c4.evidence: Timing: the $150 Mastercard Reward Card is received after the friend registers, opens the eligible account, and satisfies all program requirements.

eligibility: Security Bank of Kansas City customers referring friends/family who open a new eligible personal checking account during the promotional window.
notes: $150 promotional amount is limited-time; cap of $600/year implies 4 paid referrals.
numeric_basis: Per-referral reward of $150.00 Mastercard Reward Card.
payout_value_note: Mastercard Reward Card (gift card), not cash.

s1.note: No upfront fee charged to the referrer.

s2.note: Referral registration is free; no cost to refer.

s3.note: Tax treatment not disclosed on the official page.

s6.note: Referral mechanics stated on the official page: register online via ReferLive, invite friends by contact info/email or personal link, or refer in-branch/by phone.

s7.note: Friend-side qualifying actions: open a new eligible personal checking account during the promotional window and within 60 days receive at least $300 in ACH direct deposits, make 15 Debit Mastercard purchases, and enroll in Online Banking and eStatements.

steps: Register as a referrer at referlive.com/securitybankkc, in-branch, or by phone.
Invite friends/family via email, personal link, or the ReferLive app.
Friend registers through your referral and opens an eligible personal checking account between 2026-09-08 and 2026-10-31.
Friend completes within 60 days: at least $300 in ACH direct deposits, 15 debit purchases, and online banking/eStatements enrollment.
You receive a $150 Mastercard Reward Card.
timing: After the friend registers through the referral, opens the eligible account, and satisfies all program requirements.
when_cash_arrives: After the friend registers through the referral, opens the eligible account, and satisfies all program requirements. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
